title: Пирикарако: Минтай из Хакаты
alt: Пирикарако: Минтай из Хакаты Hakata Mentai! Pirikarako-chan 博多明太！ぴりからこちゃん
description: Hakata Mentai! Pirikarako-chan is set in a mysterious shopping center in a town that is like but also not quite like Hakata. In this setting, a walleye pollack roe fairy named Pirikarako-chan rushes about every day trying to ease the worries and solve the rumors of the other food fairies. (Source: Crunchyroll)

en:
Hakata Mentai! Pirikarako-chan is set in a mysterious shopping center in a town that is like but also not quite like Hakata. In this setting, a walleye pollack roe fairy named Pirikarako-chan rushes about every day trying to ease the worries and solve the rumors of the other food fairies.



(Source: Crunchyroll)
